# Archive notes older than a year

## 1. Problem

The notes list grows without end. Teams have notes nobody has touched in years, and finding the live ones gets harder.

## 2. What we want

- A note that has not been changed for a year moves to an archive on its own.
- Archived notes leave the notes list. They can still be opened and can be restored by an editor.
- An archived note stays out of the weekly digest.

## 3. Not now

- Choosing a different age than a year.
- Deleting archived notes.
